'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Mark Peterson LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I'm With Stupid AKA There Is Good In Stealing Decks from Reid Smith
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
